title: Learned executable job registration
summary: Jobs bind immutable names to target, argv, timeout and workdir. Local subprocesses use shell=False. Remote jobs are run via authoritative sshnode.sh; registration and each execution have separate single-use confirmations.
invariants: Show exact option/positional boundaries before registration.
A registered command does not automatically authorize an execution.
Remote executable bytes and transitive script dependencies are not fully pinned in dev8.
Do not persist secrets in argv.
Tokens and Claude hooks are not cryptographic proof of human consent.
